name: core.openwop.workflows.starters
description: Starter workflow pack (RFC 0013) — the simple-pipe on-ramp tier: short single-trigger→action recipes (webhook→notify, form→table, schedule→digest, fetch→store) that run in under a minute with zero connections, before you graduate to the AI-agent packs. Trigger-shaped starters begin with a core.trigger.* pass-through entry node: bind them to a live source with a trigger subscription (POST /v1/trigger-subscriptions — webhook, email, or form; RFC 0099) or a Schedule; on a manual run the trigger payload is empty, so bind a source to see them shine. External sends stay behind a human approval gate; in-app notifications are direct. All tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic).
author: openwop
